title: RouterConfig
description: How an agent reaches the router it is paired with, including the decrypted secret. Only ever returned to that agent, over HTTPS, to the device-token-authenticated router-config endpoint; never logged.

host.description: Host name or IP address on the home network

secret.description: The router password or SNMP community string, in plaintext

updatedAt.description: When the router's settings last changed, so the agent knows when to refresh
